purpose: Choose Home video CRT automatically by graphics tier
decision: Calibrated Royale on High/Ultra; tuned Aperture on Low/Medium; preserve explicit developer models.

notes: No-present batch includes CPU submission plus GPU completion and amortized single image readback.
Batch percentiles describe 30-frame averages, not individual GPU frame latency.
Normal fallback may retain OS display pacing despite disabled VSync and frame limit.
Effect clocks advance by1/60 per force_draw; automatic glitches are disabled.
Quality ladder uses each preset's real world resolution, antialiasing and lighting; no forced 480-line workload.

limitations: M3 Max only, not validation of low-powered hardware.
Timings include CPU submission, GPU completion and amortized readback; not gameplay FPS or pure GPU duration.
Scene, tape settings, lighting, antialiasing and output budget are held equal within each pair.
Two opposite-order rounds; three 30-frame batches per configuration per round.

casino_shadow_capture.metric: mean encoded-RGB weighted brightness (0-255), not physical luminance
